body.statement: The covariance-weighted cycle estimator satisfies \(\sqrt N(\widehat\theta_{\mathrm{eff}}-\theta_{\mathrm{PTT}})=N^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^N\phi_i^{\star}+o_P(1)\) and attains \(V^{\star}\) pointwise over \(\mathcal M_4\).
body.justification: Attainment turns the information bound into an implementable precision correction based only on cohort means and within-cohort covariances.
body.gap: Roth and Sant'Anna (2023, Proposition 2.1) optimize design-based additive estimators within a class; this result attains the superpopulation semiparametric bound for a nonlinear proportional target.
body.consumer: Applied users obtain an analytic alternative to unit-bootstrap inference for the cohort-mean PPML benchmark in fixed-horizon panels.
